depiction.primary_object: outlined cloud shape with open bottom
modifiers: upward-pointing arrow integrated into bottom line
depiction.composition: single object, front view, continuous line forming cloud and arrow

readings.meaning: cloud upload / upload to cloud storage

ambiguity: Could be confused with a plain cloud (weather) or cloud download at very small sizes if arrow direction is missed.

modifier_semantics.modifier: upward-pointing arrow integrated into bottom line
modifier_semantics.meaning: upload, send up, back up, or push to remote storage

reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a cloud with an upward-pointing arrow, the universal symbol for uploading to the cloud or performing an online backup. It is a strong, specific action/domain icon for digital file management, backups, and submissions, though care must be taken not to confuse it with cloud download at tiny sizes.
